levels.title: HSE Assistant
levels.scope: Supports site walks, records, toolbox talks and permit checks under supervision.
promotion: Completes daily checks and observation entries without reminders
Delivers a clear toolbox talk in the local language
Recognises top 10 site hazards and reports them correctly
Holds first aid and a recognised safety certificate or is enrolled
levels.nextStep: Complete NEBOSH IGC (or equivalent) and lead one weekly inspection.

levels.title: Safety Officer
levels.scope: Runs inspections, permits, training and incident reporting for a work area.
promotion: Leads inspections and closes actions on time
Investigates minor incidents and near misses with a root cause
Verifies permits and risk assessments independently
levels.nextStep: Lead an incident investigation, support an audit, begin ISO 45001 and Level 6 study.

levels.title: HSE Engineer
levels.scope: Designs controls, risk assessments, audits and KPI reporting across a project or plant.
promotion: Owns risk assessments and control design for high-risk activities
Runs internal audits and tracks KPIs (TRIR, LTIFR, closure rate)
Studying or holding NEBOSH International Diploma
levels.nextStep: Own the management system, present to senior leadership and manage budget.

levels.title: HSE Manager
levels.scope: Owns the HSE management system, culture, budget and legal compliance for the site or organisation.
promotion: Sets HSE strategy, targets and budget
Handles regulators, clients and senior management
Drives culture change and holds managers accountable
NEBOSH Level 6 International Diploma or equivalent

competencies.name: Hazard identification & site walks
actions: Do one documented site walk daily and log 5 hazards with photos
Practise spotting hazards from photos in the weekend exam

competencies.name: Risk assessment (JSA / JHA / HIRA)
actions: Write 3 JSAs for real tasks and review them with a senior
Practise the 5x5 matrix and hierarchy of controls on each hazard

competencies.name: Permit to work control
actions: Audit 10 live permits box by box and note gaps
Learn isolation, gas testing and handback steps for each permit type

competencies.name: Toolbox talks & worker communication
actions: Deliver a 5-minute talk daily with one question to workers
Prepare each talk in the workers' language and use one real photo

competencies.name: Inspections & audits
actions: Create a checklist per area and track closure dates
Shadow an internal audit and write the findings report

competencies.name: Incident investigation & Just-Culture RCA
actions: Run 5-Whys on near misses and write corrective actions
Interview workers calmly and focus on system causes, not blame

competencies.name: Legal & standards knowledge
actions: Summarise the key duties of the local OSH law on one page
Link each observation to a legal or standard clause

competencies.name: Emergency response & drills
actions: Run a fire drill and record evacuation time
Prepare plans for flood, heat, gas release and injury

competencies.name: Fire safety & extinguisher control
actions: Inspect all extinguishers monthly with tags and records
Teach fire classes and PASS technique in toolbox talks

competencies.name: PPE selection & enforcement
actions: Match PPE to the task hazard (respirator, eye, hand, fall arrest)
Run a PPE condition and fit check weekly

competencies.name: Occupational health & hygiene (heat, noise, dust, chemicals)
actions: Measure noise, heat or dust with a simple monitoring plan
Set rest, water and surveillance rules for hot or cold work

competencies.name: Contractor & client management
actions: Create a contractor induction and prequalification checklist
Hold weekly HSE meetings with contractor supervisors

competencies.name: Reporting, KPIs & data analysis (TRIR / LTIFR)
actions: Produce the monthly report with charts and closure rates
Calculate TRIR and LTIFR and explain trends to management

competencies.name: Behavioural safety & safety culture
actions: Run a positive-recognition programme alongside corrections
Coach one supervisor on safe leadership each month

competencies.name: Management systems (ISO 45001 / COR / PDCA)
actions: Map your site processes to ISO 45001 clauses
Run a PDCA review every night and every month

competencies.name: Training delivery & competence assurance
actions: Maintain a training matrix and refresher dates
Test worker understanding after each session

competencies.name: Leadership, negotiation & manager pushback handling
actions: Prepare a cost-of-accident vs cost-of-control case for each request
Document refusals in writing and escalate through the chain

competencies.name: Cost-benefit & safety budgeting
actions: Cost five recent incidents including lost time and rework
Build an annual HSE budget with justification

skills.name: Machine guarding & interlocks
actions: Inspect every machine guard and emergency stop, record defects

skills.name: Lockout / tagout & energy isolation
actions: Write machine-specific LOTO steps and audit execution

skills.name: Forklift & material handling safety
actions: Plan pedestrian segregation and operator licence checks

skills.name: Chemical handling, SDS & GHS
actions: Keep an SDS register and verify labelling and storage

skills.name: Noise, dust & ventilation control
actions: Survey high-noise and dust areas and set control measures

skills.name: Scaffolding inspection & tagging
actions: Inspect scaffolds before use and apply tag system

skills.name: Work at height & fall protection
actions: Plan rescue and anchor points for every height task

skills.name: Excavation, shoring & utilities
actions: Check soil, shoring, access and utility scans before dig

skills.name: Lifting operations & crane safety
actions: Review lift plans, load charts, slings and signaller competence

skills.name: Temporary electrical & site power
actions: Test RCDs, cables and distribution boards weekly

skills.name: Hydrocarbon release & hazardous area control
actions: Learn hazardous area classification and ignition source control

skills.name: H2S awareness & gas detection
actions: Practise detector bump tests, alarms and escape routes

skills.name: Process safety (HAZOP, MOC, barriers)
actions: Study a HAZOP report and a Management of Change record

skills.name: SIMOPS & isolation planning
actions: Review the SIMOPS matrix before each shutdown job

skills.name: Hot work & gas testing
actions: Witness gas tests and review hot work permit conditions

skills.name: ISM Code & safety management system
actions: Read the vessel SMS and map drills and audits to ISM clauses

skills.name: Enclosed space entry & rescue
actions: Practise atmosphere testing, entry permit and rescue plan

skills.name: Mooring & deck operations
actions: Inspect ropes and winches and mark snap-back zones

skills.name: Cargo H2S & gas detection
actions: Check personal detectors and cargo vapour controls

skills.name: SOLAS, lifesaving & fire appliances
actions: Inspect lifeboats, extinguishers and fire pumps on schedule
